properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 25 at 2:00PM CST until November 25 at 2:45PM CST by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
At 200 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located near Arlington, moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.
properties.instruction: TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory until 6PM CST
properties.description: South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.
properties.instruction: Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high profile vehicles. Use extra caution. Secure outdoor objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result, so keep devices charged and stay clear of fallen lines.

properties.headline: Dense Fog Advisory
properties.description: Visibility one quarter mile or less.
